name: Jaguar Temple
review:
Jaguar Temple is a 20-line Incan slot with expanding symbols and a bonus game with expanding wilds.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 2,045x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

The expanding symbols in the base game and the expanding wilds in the bonus give it a book-style rhythm. The medium-volatility maths make it calmer than most of the catalogue.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
